description: Removes for good something placed (a canvas, prop, lamp, fan, label or door) or a restricted zone, by its id from look. Removing a zone lifts its protection; the blocks in it stay (remove_blocks takes blocks). To change a thing instead, use edit_object or move_object. Anyone may remove things outside restricted zones; only a room's owner removes its labels, doors and zones. Only adding it again undoes it. Costs one edit.

id.description: Its id, as look gives it

name: remove_object
title: Remove an object
